remarks:
Owner-occupant or investment opportunity! This single-family home is currently set up and being used as a two-unit, offering plenty of possibilities for its next owner.

The front unit features a spacious living room, a large eat-in kitchen, two bedrooms, 1 bath, laundry hookups, and a covered front porch. The rear unit includes two bedrooms, an eat-in
kitchen, 1 bath, and access to the attic. Recent mechanical updates include newer hot water tanks, PEX plumbing, and updated circuit breakers in the partial basement, which is accessed from
the exterior of the home. Each unit is heated by its own forced-air furnace located in the attic.

Conveniently located near the expressway, downtown Buffalo, the Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, MLK Park, and Masten Park, this home offers easy access to work, shopping, and recreation.
Adding some TLC and cosmetic updates could make this an even greater opportunity to build equity and make it your own—whether you're looking for a place to call home or an investment property
with plenty of potential. This home is priced to sell!
